about: Every statewide record whose threshold citation, matched text, proposer or p.note changed with the two fixes of the orchestrator's check of #81 (2026-11-07 14:36), taken against 8b794e7 (#81 merged), p figures unchanged in every one. 1. Citations: the rule that governs each question by its kind, chosen by who proposed it (its ballot text's proposer where read, else its title's words, pipeline/measures.py proposer_of); where the source does not show which governs, every rule that could is cited ('A, or B'; threshold.also_governs). 'citation' is [before, after]; 'matched' the new text; 'proposer' the ballot text's proposer added (data/measure/ballot-texts.json). 2. Notes: a p taken at a threshold other than 1/2 carries a note only from the back-test near its own threshold (data/measure/backtest-measures.json, lean_notes_statewide_own_threshold: 18 questions, (s) 0.9 expected and 0 seen within 1 point, (v) under 5 expected at every line, so neither test counts and no note); 'note' is [before, after], 't' the p's threshold. data/local/REPORT.md section 20.
